name: Unleashed Software
summary: Inventory and MRP software for manufacturers and wholesalers — real-time stock across warehouses, purchasing, sales orders and batch or serial tracking. The entry price covers 3 users and 100 sales orders a month; past that the bill stacks up.
best_for: manufacturers and wholesalers who have outgrown spreadsheets and need real-time stock across multiple warehouses, with batch and serial tracking, landed costs and purchase-to-sale visibility in one system
skip_if: your order volume is low or steady enough that the included 100 a month covers it and a lighter tool would do: at that size you are buying capacity you do not use, and the per-order tiers only pay back once volume is there
honest_knock: The 100 sales orders a month included on both bundles is the number that decides your bill, not the $399. A wholesaler running 1,500 orders with six users who wants phone support pays $399 for Core, $200 for the order tier, $207 for three extra seats and $99 for Standard support. That is $905 a month, or 2.3 times the headline, before a one-off onboarding fee of at least $449. Support being a paid add-on rather than part of the plan is the detail most comparison tables miss. Price the bundle you will actually be on: count your busiest month's orders, your real seat count, and decide whether you can live without phone support, then compare that total against the alternatives rather than comparing entry prices.

pricing.notes: (prices read 2026-08-17 and re-read on 2026-10-04 on unleashedsoftware.com/pricing) Two bundles, in USD and excluding tax. Unleashed Core is $399 a month, or $4,389 a year which the page itself puts at $366 equivalent monthly. Unleashed Pro is $729 a month, or $8,019 a year at $668 equivalent monthly. The toggle promises “Save up to 10%”; the actual saving works out at 8.3% on Core and 8.4% on Pro. Both bundles come with a 14-day free trial with all features enabled and no credit card needed. What the headline covers is the part worth reading twice: Core includes 3 user licences, Pro 5, and both include just 100 sales orders a month and 250,000 or 500,000 API calls. Everything past that is priced separately. Extra users are $69 a month on Core and $89 on Pro. Sales-order upgrades run $70 (up to 500), $200 (up to 1,500), $320 (up to 3,000) or $490 (unlimited) a month. And support is a paid add-on at $99 a month for Standard or $239 for Premier. Onboarding is a one-off fee on top: $449 self-service, $799 standard, $5,549 full. Optional modules are priced on top: Advanced Inventory Manager $149 a month, Warehouse Management and Multi-Bin $149 plus $49 per warehouse device, B2B eCommerce from $129, Sales Growth from $119, Marketing Accelerator from $262 and CRM from $450.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 5 November 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We went through the trial set-up, saved one fictional product and read the plan page. We downloaded no export and did not go past the plan page of the subscribe flow.
findings: Sign-up lands in Access Evo, the Access Group's cloud shell, with Unleashed as an app inside it. The bar read 'TRIAL MODE' and '14 days remaining before your trial expires'. No card and no sales call were required.
Set-up has three steps: your goals, your business (type, size, prior inventory software) and how you heard about us. The last field is required free text.
'Use demo data' is ticked by default. We left it on, so the product list holds furniture demo rows next to our own. The welcome page says 'Delete all data' clears the demo data.

Add Product saved our test record: product code AIBM-001, description 'TEST Zoë Alpha' and a two-line note with quotation marks and an accent. The list kept the accent. We did not fill in price, tags or the second record.
The product list offers Import and an Export menu with PDF, CSV and XLSX. We did not download a file.

'Subscribe Now' opens a plan page with monthly billing preselected: CORE $399 a month (3 user licences, 100 sales orders a month, 250,000 API calls a month) and PRO $729 a month (5 user licences, 500,000 API calls). The page says prices are in USD and exclude applicable taxes, and offers annual billing with savings of up to 8%.
not_tested: Export and re-import: the export formats are offered, but we downloaded no file; the second test record was not entered
Add-ons, payment and the final price: we stopped at the plan page
Roles, support, invitations, downgrade and cancellation
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
